key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:107A2
name: poll_input_and_clear_table
description: Calls a sequence of routines that pass the codes 6 and 8 with two data pointers, then polls an input routine until it returns 1 or 2; a 2 is converted to 0 before returning. Finally it zeroes a 32-entry word table in the global block.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:10848
name: count_down_or_await_input
description: Compares a shared counter with 10. Below 10 it polls an input routine until it returns a nonzero value and returns; otherwise it decrements the counter and makes one call with argument 0.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:108E0
name: step_tick_counters
description: Increments a shared tick counter, clamped at 99, and calls a routine with argument 2 when the local tick passes 9. It also decrements a second shared counter and calls a routine with argument 0 on each pass. Parts of the recovered control flow are empty endless loops, so the decompiled flow is unreliable here.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:108E6
name: tick_counter_drain_loop
description: Repeatedly increments the shared tick counter, clamped at 99, and calls a routine with argument 2. While a second shared counter is at least 10, it decrements that counter and calls a routine with argument 0, up to ten times per pass.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:1091E
name: clear_flag_after_call
description: Calls a routine with argument 0, then clears a shared 16-bit flag word if a local argument is zero. A nonzero argument leads to an empty endless loop in the recovered code.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:10946
name: clear_shared_state_flag
description: Writes zero to one shared 16-bit flag word and returns. Nothing else is touched.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:10950
name: wait_for_nonzero_response
description: Calls a routine repeatedly until it returns a nonzero byte, then returns. It is a plain busy-wait on that single result.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:1095E
name: format_counter_digits_display
description: Turns two computed values into ASCII digits and blanks a leading zero in the first digit. It copies four bytes from a lookup table into a second text buffer, then calls the text-draw routine with codes 6 and 8 for the two buffers. It waits for an input routine to return nonzero and zeroes the 32-entry word table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:10A1E
name: invoke_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines one after the other and returns. It contains no logic of its own.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:10A7E
name: redraw_pair_and_clear_table
description: Makes three setup calls, then passes codes 6 and 8 with two text buffers to the text-draw routine. It waits for an input routine to return nonzero and zeroes the 32-entry word table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:10A8A
name: format_digits_with_temp_base
description: Stores fourteen in a shared base value, converts two routine results into ASCII digits with the leading zero blanked, and copies four table bytes into a text buffer. It draws both buffers, waits for input, zeroes the 32-entry word table and then restores the saved base value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:10B5C
name: restore_shared_value_after_draw
description: Draws two text buffers through the text-draw routine with codes 6 and 8, waits until an input routine returns nonzero, zeroes the 32-entry word table, then restores a shared word from a saved local copy.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:10BBC
name: restore_shared_value_after_calls
description: Calls two routines and then copies a saved local value back into a shared 16-bit variable.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:10BD0
name: forward_routine_register_pair
description: Calls one routine and returns the two data-register values it leaves behind, packed into a single 64-bit result.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:10BFC
name: blit_clipped_rectangle_sprite
description: Returns without drawing when the position lies outside a 336 by 176 area, and clips the start column and row to that area. It then waits for the blitter to be free and programs the blitter masks, modulos, source and destination pointers, control bits and size word for the rectangle.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:10F10
name: disable_interrupts_and_dispatch
description: Saves several shared words, writes the master-disable value and an all-bits-clear value to the interrupt enable register, clears two shared flags, then calls a handler chosen from a table by a value derived from a register.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:10F92
name: step_and_dispatch_nibble_handler
description: Advances a shared position counter by its step, defaulting to 1 when the step is zero. It reads a table byte, takes the high or low nibble by the counter's parity, and calls the handler in the jump table for that index.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:10FF0
name: swap_word_then_dispatch
description: Either stores a stack-supplied word through a pointer or swaps that pointer's word with a shared slot. It then advances the shared counter and dispatches to a jump-table handler chosen by a table nibble, as in its neighbour routines.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:1100A
name: store_word_and_dispatch
description: Writes a stack-supplied word through a pointer register, then advances the shared counter and dispatches to a jump-table handler chosen by a table nibble.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11016
name: wait_or_dispatch_by_code
description: Code 3 busy-waits on a status bit read through a pointer. Code 4 returns at once; other codes are stored in a shared word. The routine then advances the counter and dispatches through the jump table by nibble.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11030
name: store_code_unless_four_dispatch
description: Returns at once when the code argument is 4. Otherwise it advances the shared position counter by its step, reads a table nibble, saves the code in a shared word and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:1104C
name: latch_code_and_dispatch
description: Advances the shared position counter by its step, reads a table nibble, saves the word argument in a shared code slot and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11056
name: store_long_and_dispatch
description: Advances the shared position counter by its step, reads a table nibble, saves a 32-bit argument in a shared slot and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11062
name: read_sized_value_and_dispatch
description: Loads a value through a pointer as a long, word or byte, chosen by a shared mode word, and stores it in a shared slot. It then advances the position counter and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11078
name: read_byte_or_word_dispatch
description: Loads a byte or a word through a pointer, depending on a shared mode word, into a shared slot. It then advances the position counter and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11088
name: read_byte_and_dispatch
description: Loads one byte through a pointer into a shared slot, advances the position counter and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11094
name: write_sized_value_and_dispatch
description: Writes a shared slot through a pointer as a long, word or byte, chosen by a shared mode word. It then advances the position counter and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:110AE
name: write_byte_or_word_dispatch
description: Writes a shared slot through a pointer as a word or a byte, depending on a shared mode word. It then advances the position counter and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:110BE
name: write_byte_and_dispatch
description: Writes the low byte of an argument through a pointer, advances the position counter and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:110C4
name: add_operand_and_dispatch
description: Adds the 32-bit argument to a shared slot, advances the position counter and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:110CE
name: subtract_long_and_dispatch
description: Subtracts the 32-bit argument from a shared slot, advances the position counter and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:110D8
name: set_step_and_dispatch
description: Stores the word argument as the shared step value, advances the position counter by that step and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:110E2
name: offset_position_and_dispatch
description: Sets the position counter from the word argument minus the shared step, advances it and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:110F2
name: call_unrecovered_indirect_target
description: Makes an indirect call through a jump-table address the decompiler could not recover. No other logic is present, so the actual target is unknown from this evidence.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:110F6
name: reset_position_when_zero
description: When a shared slot is zero, sets the position counter from the word argument minus the shared step. It then advances the counter and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11102
name: disable_saved_register_bits
description: Writes four saved words to a hardware register, each complemented with its set-or-clear bit forced to zero, so the listed bits are cleared rather than set.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:1110E
name: subtract_long_and_dispatch
description: Subtracts the 32-bit argument from a shared slot, advances the position counter and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11120
name: add_stack_word_and_dispatch
description: Adds a stack-supplied word to the 32-bit argument, stores the sum in a shared slot, advances the position counter and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:1112C
name: advance_position_and_dispatch
description: Advances the shared position counter by its step and dispatches through the jump table, with no operand.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11132
name: load_or_store_indirect_value
description: With a null pointer argument, reloads a shared slot through a pointer chosen by a mode word, sized as byte, word or long. With a non-null argument, stores a value through that pointer. It then advances the position counter and dispatches through the jump table; the routine also rewrites the high word of a fixed pointer slot.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:1116C
name: load_word_pointer_and_dispatch
description: Loads a word through a pointer argument into a shared 32-bit slot, keeping the high half from the operand. It then advances the position counter and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11178
name: load_byte_pointer_and_dispatch
description: Loads one byte through a pointer argument into a shared 32-bit slot, combined with bits of the operand. It then advances the position counter and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11184
name: copy_indirect_long_and_dispatch
description: Follows a pointer stored at the argument address, reads the 32-bit value there and writes it through a second pointer argument. It then advances the position counter and dispatches through the jump table.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11190
name: step_counter_toward_target
description: Calls a routine repeatedly to move one shared counter toward a target counter, choosing the direction by comparison, until the two are equal. If the counter is minus one, one call is made first.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:111BE
name: wait_counter_reach_target
description: Calls a routine and keeps calling it while a shared counter differs from its target. It returns once the two values are equal.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:111C4
name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return and does nothing.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:111C6
name: poll_status_until_bit_clear
description: Repeatedly writes two byte values through an address register, calls a routine, and copies a status register into a shared word while bit 4 of that status is set. It then clears a shared counter.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:111EE
name: pulse_and_decrement_counter
description: While a shared counter is nonzero, writes two byte values through an address register, decrements the counter and returns the result of a further call. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:1120E
name: wait_for_raster_position
description: Reads the raster position register in a loop meant to wait for the scan position to change. The recovered loop condition compares the value with an offset copy of itself, so the exit condition is not recovered.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11234
name: pulse_and_increment_counter
description: While a shared counter has not reached 82, writes two byte values through an address register, increments the counter and calls a routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11256
name: clear_saved_dma_interrupt_bits
description: Writes four complemented saved words to hardware control registers, with the set-or-clear bit forced to zero, so the listed interrupt and DMA bits are cleared.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:112BC
name: split_command_line_words
description: Splits a command-line string into up to 32 words, keeping double-quoted text together and reporting an unterminated quote through a routine. It stores the word pointers in a table and sets up different shared values depending on whether any words were found.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:114FC
name: initialise_display_and_resources
description: Sets a startup flag and calls library routines to configure a 320 by 200 display. It also makes two memory requests and two timing requests, clears several shared counters and state bytes, and releases two stored handles when they are non-null.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11504
name: copy_bounded_string_into_buffer
description: Copies a null-terminated string into a buffer at an offset from its first argument, stopping at the length limit or at the terminator. It writes a terminator and returns the offset argument.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11550
name: process_pending_list_entries
description: Walks a linked list of records. For each record with flag bit 2 clear and flag bit 1 set, it calls a routine with the record's buffer fields when two stored counters differ, then makes a final call with the argument.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:115B8
name: open_intuition_and_check
description: Opens the Intuition library by name when no handle is stored, copies a value into a shared slot and calls a library routine with eight arguments. It returns 0 when that call returns 1 and minus one otherwise.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11618
name: process_flagged_table_entries
description: Walks a table of records up to a stored count. For each nonzero record without bit 2 set it calls a routine with that record's second field, then forwards its two arguments to another routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11664
name: close_stored_handles
description: Calls an optional cleanup hook when one is set, then calls a routine and closes several stored library handles when they are nonzero. It returns the first argument together with a stored value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:1166C
name: call_optional_hook_and_return
description: Calls one routine when a stored function pointer is set, then calls another routine with the argument and returns zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:1168C
name: measure_string_length
description: Advances a pointer until it reads a zero byte and returns the number of bytes before that terminator.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:116A0
name: write_and_record_error
description: Calls an optional hook when one is set, then calls a routine with three arguments. When that call returns -1, it saves the error code from a library call in a shared slot and sets a status value to 5.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:116F4
name: allocate_node_and_link
description: Allocates a block sized by the argument plus twelve bytes. On success it stores a back-pointer, links the block through a routine, makes it the list head when none exists, and returns its address plus twelve; it returns zero when allocation fails.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:1171A
name: link_node_and_return_payload
description: Links an existing block taken from the caller's frame through a routine, stores the head pointer when the shared head is empty, and returns the block address plus twelve.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11826
name: process_and_clear_node_list
description: Walks a shared linked list, passing each node and its stored field to a routine. It then clears the list head and a shared count slot.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11866
name: append_node_to_list
description: Appends a node to a list held by a head and tail pointer pair. The node's first word is cleared, it becomes the head when the list is empty, and it is linked after the current tail.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:118A8
name: multiply_32bit_words
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values from the data registers by combining the cross products of their 16-bit halves with the low-half product, and returns the 32-bit result.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:118C8
name: divide_signed_normalized
description: Divides a signed 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor. Negative operands go through a routine that negates the result, and the divisor is shifted to a normalized form before a quotient is estimated. The recovered correction path contains empty loops, so that part is unreliable.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:118E0
name: negate_64bit_result
description: Calls one routine that returns a 64-bit value and returns that value negated across both 32-bit halves.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:118EA
name: divide_32_by_16_quotient
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 16-bit divisor using normalized steps and returns the 16-bit quotient in a 32-bit value. A negative divisor is passed to a routine that negates the result. The correction path is recovered as an empty loop, so it is unreliable.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:118FA
name: divide_32bit_with_remainder
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor using normalized fixed-point steps. It returns a 64-bit value with the quotient in the high 32 bits and the remainder in the low 32 bits.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11AB4
name: check_masked_status_bits
description: Calls a routine with argument zero and the mask 12288, which covers bits 12 and 13. It returns zero when neither bit is set; otherwise it runs an optional hook and, if the hook accepts, calls a routine with argument 20 and returns the masked bits.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11B08
name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no other logic.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11B0C
name: step_shift_register_value
description: Steps a shared 32-bit shift register with a fixed feedback constant, a number of times set by the bit length of the argument minus one. It returns the low word of the register when the argument is zero, otherwise the high word of the register multiplied by the argument.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11B3A
name: multiply_16bit_high_word
description: Multiplies the low 16-bit words of two data registers and returns the upper 16 bits of the 32-bit product.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis].adf:main:3:11B58

key: runtime segment $050000-$050690:0:05E8
